title: Neural networks select hepatitis C screening candidates from a short questionnaire
summary: Among 14,042 screened participants in Oltenia, Romania, 114 were HCV-positive (prevalence 0.81%). Two ANNs trained on a 12-item questionnaire identified 97 of 119 cases (81.51%) in a separate dataset of 15,140 people using 13,401 tests, and 81 (68.06%) using 5,192 tests. The application is retrospective and resource-allocation focused.
ai_technology: Two artificial neural networks trained on questionnaire responses
organization: University of Medicine and Pharmacy of Craiova

evidence.tested: Application to an existing separate dataset of 15,140 people.
evidence.unknown: Prospective use and cost effectiveness are not tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Identified at-risk subjects to prioritize anti-HCV testing.
